accepted_conclusions: The actual smaller complete carriers were constructed, fitted, saved and strictly reloaded, but neither retained the copied unadapted parent answering function. The predeclared gate-reuse point and parent floor both failed; close this fixed Reuse condition and fitted Static control.

Reuse is below Static by0.1835037379 macro points with1/9/90 higher/lower/equal questions. These near-zero answering outcomes do not identify a generally preferable representation or justify choosing a winner from the failed-quality regime.

Both arms reduce all24 held feature errors. The24-layer equal-weight mean normalized squared-error ratio ends near0.25, not near zero. Do not describe the local blocks as highly faithful or convert that number into retained AnswerF1 or a semantic-function percentage.

Reuse has a slightly smaller held-error mean than Static yet a lower whole-model F1. This observation prevents using that local proxy alone to pass this carrier; it does not isolate why whole-model behavior failed.

The teacher inputs differ in role from compressed-network trajectories. G/U correspondence, calibration coverage, optimization budget, sequential input changes, numerical paths and generation behavior were not separated. No one of them is established as the cause.

Actual frozen endpoint trainable=0 follows fitting and final casting/freezing. It does not imply no learning or no optimizer work: each arm completed1536 local block updates. This was not continual task adaptation or a cold-start comparison.

The existing proof binds the copied parent state and source/input contracts, and new generation inputs to the parent records. Parent F1 was copied from its sealed prior proof, not rescored; a weak unadapted parent floor is still distinct from trained strong-reference performance.

RUN1072.4962113 seconds and observed exit sums1075.4496869 seconds overlap and are not added. Sampled RSS/allocator/NVML maxima cover full execution, not controlled inference memory or speed; admission/transport/review/verification/history remain additional.

design_action.rejected: Use of this fixed all24-layer diag(d)G+rank199 residual, with the specified S1 local fitting, as an answering-preserving compact starting carrier.
design_action.not_established: No evidence that independent up can be removed by this construction while preserving quality; no inference that G/U are unrelated, all sharing/low-rank schemes fail, or preserved potential rank ensures function.
design_action.remaining_functional_evidence: A real smaller complete representation that retains parent answering is still missing. Local error reduction and one reused full gate do not supply it; this result does not identify a replacement mechanism or future adaptation rule.
design_action.execution: Publish the completed negative and close the point. No new rank/LR, more recovery/data/capture/time, automatic version, continual-learning phase or full confirmation is authorized.

terminal_scope.time_boundary: This is the retained terminal snapshot, not a fresh or permanent process observation.

limitations: 100 explored DEV, one seed,20QA per domain; no stability, significance, equivalence or noninferiority conclusion.
Static has21504 more complete coefficients. It is a near-matched upper-budget control, not identical capacity, initialization or optimization geometry.
Only post-fitting full-model quality was measured in this point; the before/after feature metric does not establish a before/after whole-model F1 effect of fitting.
Selected token states and repeated block presentations are not independent images. The held feature set is lawful S1 FIT, not unseen-task or all-domain validation.
The point does not explain OSFT/PAS gains, cold-start universality, semantic knowledge acquisition, future continual learning or all non-natural-domain failures.
The measured weight reduction with failed quality is a structural negative, not a successful compact framework. Existing closed branches stay closed.
local_feature_measurement_scope: Each block was checked on held teacher-input states at the end of its local fit, before its final cast/package and without measuring the complete compressed decoder’s own internal trajectories. The reported24-layer mean is not a final-graph activation-fidelity measurement.
